content.user_title: Mine Paid Search Terms into Clear Actions
content.value_statement: Paid-search exports can hide useful queries and costly waste. This skill turns the export into keyword, negative-keyword, and n-gram actions.
actual_capabilities: Checks for query, cost, and conversion columns before making recommendations.
Identifies converting queries that can become keywords or move to matching ad groups.
Flags costly zero-conversion queries for exact or phrase negative recommendations.
Builds one-, two-, and three-gram reports ranked by measured non-converting spend.
Produces an add, negate, and move maintenance diff for a fresh export.
Reports spend-efficiency notes with measured, user-provided, or estimated labels.
limitations: It needs a search-term export with query, cost, and conversion data.
It does not change campaigns, bids, budgets, or ad groups directly.
It does not design account structure or calculate the final RQS score.
Recommendations need account-owner review before implementation.

use_cases.title: Weekly negative-keyword review
use_cases.description: Review a fresh export and prioritize costly zero-conversion queries for negative keywords.

use_cases.title: Convert query discoveries
use_cases.description: Route proven converting queries into keyword or ad-group recommendations.

use_cases.title: Agency account handoff
use_cases.description: Create a measured maintenance diff and waste summary for client review.

prompt_templates.title: Start with an export
prompt_templates.prompt: Mine this search-term export. Identify converting queries, wasted queries, and missing columns.

prompt_templates.title: Build negatives
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a negative-keyword list from this export. Use a stated cost floor and recommend exact or phrase match types.

prompt_templates.title: Find waste patterns
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a one-, two-, and three-gram waste report from these non-converting search terms. Rank tokens by measured cost.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a maintenance diff
prompt_templates.prompt: Using this search-term export and direct-response goal, produce add, negate, and move recommendations. Label every metric by its evidence source.

output_examples.input: A search-term export with cost, conversions, and conversion value.
output: Add: “running shoes for flat feet” as a keyword because it has measured conversions.
Negate: “free running shoes” as a phrase negative after measured spend with zero conversions.
Waste pattern: “free” is a top non-converting token by measured cost.

output_examples.input: An export without a conversion column.
output_examples.output: Stop the analysis and request a conversion column. Do not recommend keyword harvesting or negatives from clicks alone.

best_practices: Use a fresh export and state the reporting period before analysis.
Set a clear conversion threshold and cost floor before making recommendations.
Review proposed negatives for relevance before applying them to an account.
anti_patterns: Do not negate queries using clicks alone when conversion data is missing.
Do not treat estimated metrics as measured export data.
Do not use this skill to redesign campaigns or reallocate budgets.

faq.question: What data does this skill need?
faq.answer: It needs query, cost, and conversion columns. Conversion value is useful for ROAS analysis.

faq.question: Can it use a pasted report?
faq.answer: Yes. You can paste the export data when a file is unavailable.

faq.question: Does it add keywords automatically?
faq.answer: No. It creates recommendations for the account owner to review and apply.

faq.question: How are negative keywords selected?
faq.answer: It flags meaningful spend with zero conversions and recommends a match type and level.

faq.question: Can it analyze n-grams?
faq.answer: Yes. It ranks one-, two-, and three-gram tokens by measured non-converting spend.

faq.question: Does it manage budgets or bids?
faq.answer: No. Budget and bid changes are outside this skill’s scope.
